title: Network-based pharmacological study of the mechanism of Baitouweng decoction in the treatment of ulcerative colitis through the NF-kappaB pathway.
authors: Bai, Shanze; Chen, Baoxia; Li, Fang; Yao, Wanling; Wei, Yanming; Hua, Yongli
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子对接研究白头翁汤治疗溃疡性结肠炎的NF-kappaB通路机制，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Baitouweng decoction (BD) is a classic formula for the treatment of ulcerative colitis (UC) with remarkable efficacy and low recurrence rate, although the therapeutic mechanism is still unclear. To screen out the active components and study the mechanisms of BD treating UC. METHODS: A network pharmacology strategy was used to screen the active ingredients and pathways of action of BD for the treatment of UC, and the binding activity of the screened active ingredients to the core targets was examined by molecular docking with Autodock Vina software, a macrophage inflammation model was established, administration of BD and its screened active ingredients, determination of relevant inflammatory cytokine levels and expression of pathway-related proteins to verify the mechanism of action of BD in the treatment of UC. RESULTS: Forty-five active components of BD, 186 relevant targets of UC, and 67 core intersecting genes of BD and UC were screened. Enrichment analysis revealed that the molecular mechanisms of BD treatment of UC are associated with IL-17, TNF-alpha, and Toll-like receptor signaling pathways, and that these signaling pathways all point to NF-kappaB-based inflammatory signaling pathways. Molecular docking suggests that the active components of BD, epiberberine, beta-sitosterol, and anemoside B4 have a strong affinity for targets such as MPO, NOS3, and PPARG. MPO, NOS3, and PPARG can affect cytokine secretion and protein expression directly or indirectly through the NF-kappaB signaling pathway. Cell Counting Kit-8 results showed that BD and the active ingredient, in a range of nontoxic concentrations, increased cell survival in a model of LPS-induced cellular inflammation. BD and active ingredients could decrease LPS-induced inflammation and the levels of TNF-alpha, PGE2, IL-17, iNOS, IL-1beta, COX-2, and NO. On the other hand, BD and the active ingredient promoted the expression and inhibited the phosphorylation of p65 and IkappaBalpha in the NF-kappaB signaling pathway in LPS-induced inflammation. CONCLUSIONS: beta-sitosterol, stigmasterol, quercetin, isorhamnetin, berberine, and anemoside B4 may be the material basis for BD treatment of UC, which exerts anti-inflammatory effects by regulating the expression of inflammatory factors and modulating the NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 背景：白头翁汤（BD）是治疗溃疡性结肠炎（UC）的经典方剂，疗效显著且复发率低，但其治疗机制尚不清楚。本研究旨在筛选白头翁汤的活性成分，并探讨其治疗UC的作用机制。方法：采用网络药理学策略筛选白头翁汤治疗UC的活性成分及作用通路，并通过Autodock Vina软件进行分子对接，检测筛选出的活性成分与核心靶点的结合活性；建立巨噬细胞炎症模型，给予白头翁汤及其筛选出的活性成分，测定相关炎症细胞因子水平和通路相关蛋白表达，以验证白头翁汤治疗UC的作用机制。结果：筛选出白头翁汤的45个活性成分、UC相关靶点186个，以及白头翁汤与UC的67个核心交集基因。富集分析显示，白头翁汤治疗UC的分子机制与IL-17、TNF-alpha和Toll样受体信号通路相关，且这些信号通路均指向基于NF-kappaB的炎症信号通路。分子对接提示，白头翁汤的活性成分表小檗碱、β-谷甾醇和白头翁皂苷B4与MPO、NOS3和PPARG等靶点具有较强亲和力。MPO、NOS3和PPARG可通过NF-kappaB信号通路直接或间接影响细胞因子分泌和蛋白表达。Cell Counting Kit-8结果显示，白头翁汤及其活性成分在无毒浓度范围内，可提高LPS诱导的细胞炎症模型中的细胞存活率。白头翁汤及其活性成分可降低LPS诱导的炎症反应及TNF-alpha、PGE2、IL-17、iNOS、IL-1beta、COX-2和NO的水平。另一方面，白头翁汤及其活性成分在LPS诱导的炎症中促进了NF-kappaB信号通路中p65和IkappaBalpha的表达，并抑制其磷酸化。结论：β-谷甾醇、豆甾醇、槲皮素、异鼠李素、小檗碱和白头翁皂苷B4可能是白头翁汤治疗UC的物质基础，其通过调节炎症因子表达和调控NF-kappaB信号通路发挥抗炎作用。
